Title: General Availability of Azure Logic Apps connectors for IBM Mainframe and Midranges

Body.Content:
Exciting news!  Azure Logic Apps connectors for IBM Mainframe and Midrange, including IBM 3270, IBM CICS, IBM DB2, IBM i, IBM MQ, and IBM IMS, are now generally available. These connectors address highly sought-after customer requests, bring capabilities to extend Azure Logic Apps cloud native workloads with some of the oldest systems ever built for Mainframes and Midranges. 

Benefits to you:

  • Flexibility: Choose from Cloud (Public/Hybrid) deployment options to suit your infrastructure needs.
  • Reliability: Leverage mature Host Integration Server technologies for seamless integration with Mainframe and Midrange systems.
  • Agility: Accelerate time-to-market and responsiveness to business demands with agile workflows.
  • Cost Savings: No dependency on third-party libraries means significant cost savings compared to other solutions.
  • Seamless Transition: Transition to cloud environments without impacting Mainframes or Midranges, avoiding issues associated with aging infrastructures.
  • Skills Availability: Low-Code platform simplifies integration processes, making it easier to find skilled personnel.
  • Modernization: Easily provide REST capabilities in Mainframes and Midranges for streamlined operations.

Learn more how our Azure Logic Apps IBM connectors can modernize your Mainframe and Midrange systems here.
